_provenance: PROVISIONAL. X API v2 403 standing in for a pay-per-use billing/entitlement rejection (insufficient credit or missing product / access level). The real credit-exhaustion body is not publicly documented — COST-6 names capturing it a Phase-1 live-test task, after which this fixture is locked. Shape modelled on the legacy access-level 403. Captured 2026-07-23. Exercises: billing class (COST-6/7), distinct from the local budget class.

body.title: Client Forbidden
body.detail: This endpoint is not available with your current access level. You may need a different access level to reach this endpoint, or your prepaid credit is exhausted.
